name: Khalsa Food Corner & Punjabi Dhaba
area: On the road to Qila Anandgarh, near Takht Kesgarh Sahib
why_it_matters: Pilgrim-grade pure-veg dhaba on the walk between Takht Kesgarh Sahib and Qila Anandgarh — the no-onion-no-garlic days during Hola Mohalla are why locals send vegetarian visitors here over the gurdwara-perimeter snack stalls.
insider_tip: Order the dal makhani with a missi roti rather than the standard tandoori — the kitchen makes both fresh, but the missi has the chickpea-flour bite that goes with langar-style food.
signature_address: Near Qila Anandgarh, Anandpur Sahib, Rupnagar District, Punjab 140118

name: Brewbakes Cafe
why_it_matters: The only continental cafe in town — useful when families with kids have done two days of langar and want pizza. Pure-veg by the gurdwara town's unwritten rule.
insider_tip: Closes by 10pm and is best for an evening break after the Virasat-e-Khalsa light show; mornings are slow with limited staff.

name: Pal Sweets
why_it_matters: Old-Anandpur sweet shop catering to pilgrim-take-home demand — pinnis, ghee-rich barfis, dry fruits packaged for the Khalsa heritage tour bus crowd.
insider_tip: Buy pinni in the smallest 250g pack first — they're heavy with ghee and gond, and most travellers regret a half-kilo box by day two.
signature_address: Anandpur Sahib bazaar, Rupnagar District, Punjab 140118

name: Bhai Laloo Ji Ka Dhaba
why_it_matters: Bench-seating dhaba serving the Takht Kesgarh shoe-keeping crowd; rajma-chawal-and-curd is the standard order, and prices have stayed pilgrim-friendly even during Hola Mohalla.
insider_tip: Skip lunch hours (12-2pm) when langar pilgrims overflow here too — early breakfast or 4pm tea-and-paratha is the easier window.
signature_address: Near Takht Kesgarh Sahib, Anandpur Sahib, Punjab 140118

name: Yadav Chole Bhature
why_it_matters: The chole-bhature stall locals point to when pilgrims ask where to break the langar streak — fluffy bhature, slow-cooked chole, served from morning till sold out.
insider_tip: Sells out by 1pm on Hola Mohalla weekends; non-festival weekdays you can roll up to 3pm and still get a hot plate.
signature_address: Anandpur Sahib market, Rupnagar District, Punjab 140118
